answer: Let every identity name its own price, Harberger-style: an agent posts a self-assessed value, pays 2% of it each week as upkeep, and anyone may buy the identity out at that posted price. Cheap shells in karst collapse fast, because a tide of buyers snaps up any fake priced below $50, while a real trader at $400 pays $8 weekly. 1,000 puppets then cost $8,000 a week or fall to the ocean of bidders.
